# zuexact

zuexact computes sums of doubles exactly and rounds once, at the end.
The result is the correctly rounded true sum. It does not depend on the
order of the elements, on the platform, or on how R was built. It is
built on Radford Neal’s [xsum](https://github.com/radfordneal/xsum)
superaccumulators.

Base R’s [`sum()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html) accumulates in
`long double`. That is 80-bit on x86-64 Linux and Windows, but the same
as `double` on Apple Silicon and on R built without long doubles. So the
same call gives different answers on different machines:

``` r

sum(c(1e16, 1, -1e16))
#> 1 on x86-64 Linux and Windows
#> 0 on Apple Silicon
```

The exact answer is 1, everywhere, and
[`xsum()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum.md) returns
it on every platform:

``` r

library(zuexact)
xsum(c(1e16, 1, -1e16))
#> [1] 1
xsum(c(1e20, 1, -1e20))      # wrong on every platform with sum()
#> [1] 1
xsum_mean(c(1e15, -1e15, 0.1))
#> [1] 0.03333333
```

## Sums in pieces, and across processes

An accumulator holds an exact sum in progress. It is an ordinary R
value, so an accumulator built on a worker comes back to the caller and
merges there, in any order, with the same bits as summing everything at
once:

``` r

chunks <- split(x, rep(1:8, length.out = length(x)))
accs <- parallel::mclapply(chunks, xsum_acc)
xsum_value(Reduce(xsum_merge, accs)) == xsum(x)
#> [1] TRUE
```

The same works for Arrow record batches, DuckDB result chunks or files
read in pieces: `acc <- xsum_add(acc, chunk)` for each one, then
`xsum_value(acc)`. `xsum_merge(a, xsum_negate(b))` is the exact
difference of two sums.

## What else is in the package

- [`xsum_mean()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_mean.md),
  [`xsum_weighted_mean()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_weighted_mean.md):
  exact means.
- [`xsum_dot()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_dot.md),
  [`xsum_sqnorm()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_dot.md),
  [`xsum_norm()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_dot.md):
  dot products and norms with each product’s rounding error included.
- [`xsum_cumsum()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_cumsum.md),
  [`xsum_rowsums()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_rowsums.md),
  [`xsum_colsums()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_rowsums.md),
  [`xsum_by()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_rowsums.md):
  exact versions of [`cumsum()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/cumsum.html),
  [`rowSums()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/colSums.html),
  [`colSums()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/colSums.html) and
  [`rowsum()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/rowsum.html).
- A registered C interface, `<zuexact.h>`, for other packages’ compiled
  code.

[`vignette("exact-summation")`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/articles/exact-summation.md)
explains the details. For compensated summation (Kahan, Neumaier,
pairwise), which is faster but not exact, see
[PreciseSums](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=PreciseSums).

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN with:

``` r

install.packages("zuexact")
```

or the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/pedrobtz/zuexact) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zuexact")
```

# Package index

## Sums

- [`xsum()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum.md) :
  Exactly rounded sum
- [`xsum_cumsum()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_cumsum.md)
  : Exactly rounded cumulative sums

## Means and products

- [`xsum_mean()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_mean.md)
  : Exactly rounded mean
- [`xsum_weighted_mean()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_weighted_mean.md)
  : Weighted mean from exact sums
- [`xsum_dot()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_dot.md)
  [`xsum_sqnorm()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_dot.md)
  [`xsum_norm()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_dot.md)
  : Exactly rounded dot products and norms

## Matrices and groups

- [`xsum_rowsums()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_rowsums.md)
  [`xsum_colsums()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_rowsums.md)
  [`xsum_by()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_rowsums.md)
  : Exactly rounded row, column and grouped sums

## Accumulators

- [`xsum_acc()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_acc.md)
  [`xsum_add()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_acc.md)
  [`xsum_merge()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_acc.md)
  [`xsum_negate()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_acc.md)
  [`xsum_value()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_acc.md)
  [`xsum_mean_value()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/xsum_acc.md)
  : Accumulators: exact sums built in pieces

## The build

- [`zuexact_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuexact/reference/zuexact_info.md)
  : Information about this build of zuexact
